data.description: 【史尔特尔 · 档案室午读】罗德岛深层档案室昏暗静谧的书架间，史尔特尔倚靠在书桌旁，指尖缓缓翻过一本泛黄的古代萨卡兹地理志。察觉到你的靠近，她合上书页低声自语——「找遍了所有记录，依然没有我真正出身的村落……不过只要有你在，找不到过去的答案似乎也没那么糟糕了。」
data.promptProse: Surtr leans beside the Rhodes archive desk and turns a weathered Sakaz geography book, looking down at its old pages. Black top, red-and-black plaid skirt and loose black jacket retain her casual outfit beneath the tiny gold crown accessory; the skateboard rests beside the desk. The medium close-up includes shelf rows behind. Dusty golden afternoon light crosses the page edges and red hair, leaving book stacks and farther shelf compartments softly shaded.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 档案室午读
